summary: Frontend-only verification of the restructured /tablet POS at 1920x800. All 8 owner-requested acceptance criteria pass. Playwright measurements confirm the right 'Votre commande' panel is STATIC and full-height (touching the header at y=74), the LEFT product section is the only region that scrolls, and the category tab bar remains fixed above the scrolling product grid.
critical_code_review_comments: TabletOrder.jsx is ~702 lines (just over the 700 line soft limit). Extract FulfillmentButton, Field, CategoryTabs, CustomerSearch and cart-line row into separate files.

The middle section of the right aside (customer search / name / notes) is itself overflow-y-auto. This is correct for the requested layout but means very tall customer forms will scroll INSIDE the right panel — verify this matches the owner's mental model (fulfillment at top and Total/Valider at bottom always stay pinned, which they do).
cartPayload effect dep list still uses items.length instead of cartPayload, so line-content changes (sauce/removal edits) without qty change may not re-quote. Minor, out of current scope.
verified_acceptance_criteria: 2. 9 category tabs (tablet-category-select-*) live in LEFT column above grid, use flex-wrap (nav width 1540 fits in 1 row here but no horizontal scroll strip; wraps on narrower widths) and stay at y=74 unchanged after scrolling the left product section 800px.
3. Grid uses sm:grid-cols-3 → exactly 3 cards per row on wide viewport (first 3 cards at y=199, next 3 at y=~404). Cards render in dense mode (small BT placeholder, small name, small Ajouter button).

4. SCROLL INDEPENDENCE VERIFIED: after scrolling the left <section> 800px, aside header, tablet-fulfillment-group (y=151), tablet-order-total (y=672) and tablet-submit-order (y=720) did not move (delta = 0px) and all remain inside the 800px viewport.

5. tablet-fulfillment-group with -pickup/-delivery/-dine-in sits at the TOP of the right panel (y=151, just under aside header). Livraison reveals tablet-address-one and tablet-city (no postal). Switching to À emporter hides the address block.
6. Add-to-cart works: clicking a card's Ajouter opens the config modal, confirming adds a line with working +/- steppers (qty 1→2→1) and clear-cart empties the panel.
7. tablet-delivery-slot dropdown shows SINGLE times ('21:15', '21:30', '21:45', '22:00') in 15-minute steps, not ranges.
8. No email input anywhere on the page; no payment-method selector present.
seed_data_creation: None — no orders submitted (per instruction, Valider/Encaisser was NOT clicked to avoid triggering real ESC/POS printing).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The layout uses outer h-screen flex-col, then a grid [1fr,380px]. LEFT column is min-h-0 flex-col with a wrapping <nav> + a flex-1 overflow-y-auto <section>. RIGHT <aside> is min-h-0 flex-col with its own overflow-y-auto in the middle and pinned header/fulfillment top + total/submit bottom. To reproduce scroll-independence tests, scroll the LEFT <section> (the one containing menu-item cards) not window; the aside's y-position stays 74 and total/submit at 672/720.
